title: Signal grooming + sprint notes: tracing & dashboard cost experiment
content:
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Claire, Samir, Maya (10am PT standup)

Purpose: weekly grooming focused on tracing signal hygiene, dashboard debt, and a quick cost-reduction experiment kickoff for span ingestion. Capture decisions, action items, and open questions.

High-level notes:
- Quick status: most dashboard widgets migrated to metric-backed panels. Remaining ~7 panels still using live-trace queries (slow, expensive).
- Trace ingest cost spiked last week after internal A/B; suspected cause: sampling config accidentally disabled for keynote service, see OBS-7342.
- Observed a 22% increase in span-store egress/TCP connections correlated with 2026-07-29 deploy.

Data/metrics called out (raw snippets):
- span-store cost (last 7d): $12.4k -> $15.1k (delta +21.8%)
- avg trace ingest rate: 1.9M spans/min -> 2.3M spans/min during peak
- high-p99 latency on trace-query endpoints (dash-qry-prod): 450ms -> 780ms after dashboard refresh surge

Decisions agreed:
1) Temporary sampling patch: roll back the faulty sampling policy and deploy adaptive sampling config for internal services. Target: 40-60% sample for verbose internal services for 72h window. Owner: Ethan. Jira: OBS-7361.
2) Convert 5 remaining trace-backed dashboard panels to pre-aggregated metric panels (rate(), histograms). Owner: Claire + Maya pairing. Aim for end-of-sprint.
3) Add a daily cost pulse metric to the monitoring homepage: span-ingest-cost-24h and span-ingest-rate-24h. Owner: Samir.
4) Create a low-latency cached dashboard (read-only refresh every 30s) for on-call to avoid trace-query surges. Owner: Priya.

Action items (with mini-implementation notes):
- Ethan: implement sampling rollback + adaptive sampling experiment (OBS-7361). Steps: revert config in otel-pipeline, add adaptive sampler script (PR stub: telemetry#2043), run smoke test against staging. ETA: 2026-08-08.
- Claire: inventory trace-backed panels (list attached inline). Convert top-5 high-cost ones first. Use metrics: traces.per_second, spans.per_trace, span_size_bytes sample aggregation. ETA: 2026-08-13.
- Maya: prototype cached read-only dashboard using metrics exporter and redis ttl (30s). Low-risk: read-only for on-call. ETA: 2026-08-11.
- Samir: add alert + grafana panel for daily span-ingest-cost spike (>15% day-over-day). Add slack webhook to #observability-alerts. Also create billing tag query. ETA: 2026-08-09.
- Priya: document rollback/runbook snippet in ops-runbooks repo under tracing/runbooks/sampling-fixes.md. Include rollback commands, verification queries, and postmortem checklist. ETA: 2026-08-10.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: under-sampling could hide real regressions. Mitigation: run adaptive sampling that biases toward error traces and high-latency traces (config note: keep head-based sampling on exceptions).
- Risk: converting panels might remove critical context. Mitigation: preserve drilldown links to trace explorer and keep raw-query versions in an archived folder.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Should we enable per-customer sampling controls for heavy enterprise accounts? (brief discussion; leaning yes for Dedicated customers — follow-up with product). Owner: Priya to sync with product-hosted-api.
- What is the budget threshold for automatic throttling of trace-query dashboards? (TBD; propose $500/day for ad-hoc dashboards).

Short experiment plan (Ethan): adaptive-sampling A/B
- Group A: revert to default sampler (baseline)
- Group B: adaptive sampler with error/latency bias + periodic full-traces sample (1% full)
- Measurement windows: 48h pre, 72h experiment, compare span-store cost, p99 query latency, missed-error-rate.
- Success criterion: >=15% reduction in span-store cost without >5% increase in missed-error-rate.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- trending: alert fatigue on billing tags. Need consolidated billing dashboard.
- flagged the streaming-kv connector for review — causes small bursts at 03:00 UTC when GC kicks in.
- Claire: check GA for dashboard view counts (which panels cause refreshes)

Attachments / quick refs (manual list):
- inventory stub: panel ids: [panel-9821, panel-9923, panel-10102, panel-10145, panel-10188, panel-10211, panel-10300]
- quick queries:
  * verify sampling rollback: count(spans{service="keynote"}) by 1m - should drop ~45% after patch
  * p99 query latency check: histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(trace_query_latency_bucket[5m]))

Communication plan:
- Post short summary to #observability after sampling rollback (Ethan) with links to the runbook and quick verification queries.
- If cost does not improve in 72h, escalate to infra-oncall and schedule hotfix window.

Retro / follow-up agenda for next grooming: 2026-08-13
- Review sampling experiment metrics (cost delta, detection of errors)
- Walk through converted dashboards and get on-call signoff
- Decide on per-customer sampling gating for Dedicated customers

Random notes / scribbles:
- Consider adding a lightweight span-metadata index for quick cardinality checks (store small hash + tag keys)
- Might be worth a small spike: compress span payloads at agent side for internal SDKs (trade CPU for net cost).

End of notes.

Drafted by Priya Nambiar (observability lead) — quick capture, will expand into runbook and attach PR links once opened.
